text: Management Science and Engineering (MS&E for short) is an interdisciplinary field that integrates knowledge from various domains such as management, mathematics, statistics, economics, and computer science. Its aim is to address complex management issues through quantitative analysis and optimization methods, thereby enhancing organizational efficiency, decision-making quality, and system performance. It emphasizes the use of scientific models and technical tools (such as data analysis, algorithm optimization, and simulation) to solve practical management challenges, covering a wide range of scenarios from enterprise operations to social systems.
